title: Existence of balanced integral reindexing maps
statement: Fix the data of [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data] and a function-normalized RingReindex B as in [def-sf-native-adic-reindexing-data]. For every finite coefficient field E there is an IntegralReindex map I(E) for B.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; explicit subargument of lem-sf-adic-reindexing-core, not a verbatim statement of either source.

proof.text: Construct the balanced integral reindexing family E ↦ I(E) by comparing the finite quotient projections of the completed coefficient sheaves, using the coefficient cartesian and finite-colimit statements and the inverse-image tensor/Hom comparison. The result is a Nonempty family of IntegralReindex maps; no realization comparison is used.

theorem exists_integral_reindexing_maps (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (d : ∀ T : GeometricSpace D, SpaceData l D T)
    (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
    (B : RingReindex l T.base.left g.hom (d T).realization (d U).realization) :
    letI := (d T).units
    letI := (d U).units
    Nonempty (∀ E, IntegralReindex l T.base.left g.hom B E)
